docs.title: Frontend
docs.text: This section details the repository file distributions, framework configurations, and data architecture patterns implemented across the client interface layers.

docs.title: Application Client Channels
docs.text:
The FikaMarket ecosystem isolates its operational workflows across three distinct technical channels based on target user accessibility criteria:

  • Lead Farmer Portal (PWA Dashboard): Developed using Next.js to manage regional collection channels, aggregate yields, and performance tracking grids.
  • Buyer Mobile Platform: Developed using Flutter to supply native mobile processing, line-item shopping carts, escrow checkouts, and local data persistence.
  • Farmer Communication Matrix: A purely text-driven offline client matrix routing feature-phone endpoints through the system's central backend USSD gateway.

docs.title: Lead Farmer Portal Architecture (Next.js)
docs.text: The web client runs a highly structured Next.js framework designed for immediate layout rendering and clean component modularization.

docs.title: Framework Dependencies
docs.text:
• Core Systems: Next.js 16.3.1 (App Router Interface) & React / React-Dom 19.2.8
  • Styling Engine: TailwindCSS and PostCSS ^4 matching global core layout variables
  • Forms Matrix: React Hook Forms driving real-time validation layers
  • Data Visualizations: Recharts metrics canvas blocks embedded directly within the dashboard view
  • Icon Assets: Lucide React optimized inline SVG vector layers
  • Typography: Roboto global font-family configurations

docs.title: Buyer Mobile Application Architecture (Flutter)
docs.text: The mobile platform delivers high runtime efficiency while preserving data usability in low-connectivity agricultural field environments.

docs.title: Data Architecture & Offline Behaviors
docs.text:
• Screen Workflows: User onboarding logic is handled explicitly inside signup_screen.dart and login_screen.dart. Buyers evaluate crop lots inside market_place.dart and commit listings to cart_model.dart.
  • Offline Cache Processing: The application uses a local storage layer to cache active product tables. Users can query listings, modify carts, and stage orders completely offline. Data packets automatically sync to the FikaMarket core database once connectivity is restored.

docs.title: Repository Commit and Merge Pipeline
docs.text:
Before pushing local branches to the remote production tracking systems, ensure your code passes our integration safeguards.

git status
git add .
git commit -m "feat: implement frontend route boundaries"
git push origin feature/frontend-core

docs.title: System Testing & Quality Assurance
docs.text:
FikaMarket uses a structured test case register containing 250+ documented test cases to ensure full traceability between system requirements and implementation.

!!! info "Test Case Classification" Every test case tracks essential metadata: Test ID, Linked Requirement, User Story, Severity, Preconditions, Test Data, and Expected Results. Tests are executed using three methodologies:

**Automated:** Executed via automated test runners and API scripts.
**Manual:** Human-verified edge cases and network interruptions.
**Hybrid:** Combined manual setup with automated verification.

docs.title: Test Coverage Overview
docs.text:
Our test suite guarantees complete coverage across all core system channels and components:

  • User Channels: Farmer USSD Flow & Buyer/Lead Farmer PWA interfaces.
  • Core Marketplace: Produce listing, real-time market price feeds, and order placement.
  • Backend Processing: Payment processing, secure escrow splitting, and webhook handlers.
  • External Integration: Gateway SMS notifications and third-party API connectivity.

docs.title: API Testing with Postman
docs.text: We leverage Postman to validate backend business logic, response payloads, status codes, and input validation schemas.

docs.title: Execution Workflow
docs.text: Open Postman ──> Select FikaMarket Collection ──> Set Environment ──> Send Request ──> Run Scripts ──> Pass/Fail

docs.title: Postman Test Scripts
docs.text:
Automated test scripts verify API responses instantly. For example, to validate a successful endpoint response:

pm.test("Status code is 200", function () {
    pm.response.to.have.status(200);
});

docs.title: Running Test Batches
docs.text: !!! success "Collection Runner" For bulk testing or regression runs, use the Postman Collection Runner to execute entire test folders sequentially, inject test iterations, and view real-time assertion graphs.
